description: This source file defines a helper class 'CallChainReentrancyTestHelper' for testing reentrancy scenarios in Orleans grains. It includes various asynchronous test methods to simulate different call chain configurations and reentrancy behaviors, as well as an inner class for observing and synchronizing call chain operations.

classes.name: CallChainReentrancyTestHelper
classes.description: A helper class designed for testing reentrancy scenarios in Orleans grains by executing various call chain configurations and managing their synchronization.

classes.name: CallChainObserver
classes.description: Inner class implementing ICallChainObserver to monitor and synchronize call chain operations during tests.

methods.name: CallChainReentrancy_1
methods.description: Simulates a call chain with allowed reentrancy between the same grain.

methods.name: CallChainReentrancy_2
methods.description: Simulates a call chain with reentrancy across different grains.

methods.name: CallChainReentrancy_3
methods.description: Sets up a call chain with alternating reentrancy and non-reentrancy conditions.

methods.name: CallChainReentrancy_4
methods.description: Simulates a call chain with no deadlock scenarios involving the same grain.

methods.name: CallChainReentrancy_5
methods.description: Simulates a call chain where reentrancy is enabled only on mixed grain combinations.

methods.name: CallChainReentrancy_6
methods.description: Tests full chain reentrancy with multiple grains in the call chain.

methods.name: CallChainReentrancy_WithSuppression
methods.description: Test method demonstrating suppression of call chain reentrancy to prevent specific reentrant calls.
